title: Bias of coordinate marginals
statement: Let $\phi$ be a probability density on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ that is $\varepsilon$-biased, meaning every nonzero Fourier frequency has coefficient of absolute value at most $\varepsilon$. For every set $J$ of coordinates, the marginal of $\phi$ on those coordinates is also $\varepsilon$-biased.
